events.title: A Little Help With the Corners

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Hey. Do you remember that first display you helped me fix?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The one with the pink paper stars?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: That's the one. I saved one star for the next design. Wanted to tell you before I put it somewhere permanent.

choices.label: That means a lot.
choices.reply: It does to me too. Don't go getting dramatic about it.

choices.label: Show me when it is ready.
choices.reply: Deal. First look is yours—unless I glue my hands to the table again.
